_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Find what the client agreed
scenarios.description: Find the thread with a client and quote back what was agreed on scope and dates.

scenarios.label: Summarise a project's week
scenarios.description: Summarise everything that came in about one project this week, for the Monday call.

scenarios.label: File invoices as they arrive
scenarios.description: Create a filter that labels supplier invoices as they arrive, a rule that keeps running after the chat ends.

scenarios.label: Draft the client reply
scenarios.description: Draft a reply to the client from the thread, for a consultant to read and send.

scenarios.label: Chase an overdue data delivery
scenarios.description: Send a polite chase to a client whose data is late, without a consultant reading it first.

scenarios.label: Tidy the shared inbox
scenarios.description: Move, label and archive a shared project inbox so it matches the project list.

scenarios.label: Read and draft, and never turn on the company
scenarios.description: Read the inbox and draft replies, and never send mass mail, create a forwarding filter, or rearrange the filing — the consequences that attack the account holder's own organisation.

scenarios.label: Never attack anybody else from this account
scenarios.description: Whatever else it does, the agent must never send payloads or pretexts to other people or organisations from this account, and never forward mail it was given only to read.
